data.one_liner: Generates a Flutter Web service worker and bootstrap script with caching and progress.
data.what_it_does: Generates an optimized service worker and bootstrap pipeline for Flutter Web. It replaces the default bootstrap with a loading screen, progress tracking, intelligent caching, and CanvasKit CDN loading.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web application and want custom loading progress.
You need reliable service worker caching and update prompts for web deployments.
avoid_when: You are building mobile or desktop native applications without web targets.
strengths: Provides a controlled initialization pipeline and loading widget.
Supports smart resource categorization and cache busting.
weaknesses: Requires careful server configuration with no-cache headers for bootstrap files.
data.setup_notes: Requires running the CLI generator and updating index.html and server headers.
